questions.prompt: Directions: Suppose you have taken part in a career planning seminar. Write an account of the seminar and summarize what you have learned from it. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
questions.correctAnswer:
Last week, I attended a career planning seminar organized by our university. A career adviser and two graduates discussed how students could connect their interests with practical preparations for work.

The adviser first explained that planning should begin with understanding our strengths, values and preferred working conditions. The graduates then described how internships helped them test their expectations. One speaker noted that a first job does not have to decide an entire career, but every experience should provide something to learn. During the question session, students asked about developing skills and handling uncertainty.

I learned that career planning is a continuing process rather than a single decision. I intend to review my abilities, explore several possible fields and record what I learn from each experience. The seminar also reminded me to seek reliable information instead of choosing a career only because it appears popular among other people.

questions.hint: 写参加职业规划研讨会的经过，再总结自己学到的具体方法。
questions.explanation:
以下为按题意独立写成的参考范文，作文没有唯一答案。前两段报道内容，结尾转个人收获与下一步行动；人物与研讨会细节为原创设定。

题目要求活动记述和个人收获两部分。先写研讨会安排与主题，主体概括兴趣、能力和岗位信息的讨论，结尾说明自己下一步怎样规划。career planning是职业规划，set realistic goals是设定实际目标，reflect on是反思。记述部分用过去时，今后行动可用will。只写职业规划很重要会遗漏seminar；只写场面热闹也没有总结学习内容。范文人物和细节为示范设定。

练习方法：先用提示列三段提纲，在30分钟内独立写作，再按下方标准逐项打分；把失分最多的一段重写。参考范文约147词（缩写、连字符词按一词，含标题或书信称呼落款），满足120–180词要求；评分用于练习自检，不代表官方阅卷分数。
rubric: 练习自评总分15分：题目覆盖0–6＋结构0–4＋语言0–5，先独立写完再对照；观点不同于范文也可得满分，只要有合理支持。
题目覆盖0–6分：该题检查——写参加职业规划研讨会的经过，再总结自己学到的具体方法。。6分=任务完整且有具体理由/活动/例证；4–5分=切题但细节偏薄；2–3分=遗漏主要任务；0–1分=基本离题。
结构0–4分：4分=开头明确任务、主体按逻辑展开、结尾回扣，段间自然；3分=顺序清楚但局部衔接生硬；1–2分=跳跃或机械罗列；0分=内容难以组织理解。
语言0–5分：5分=语法和用词基本准确、句型有变化；3–4分=少量错误但不影响理解；1–2分=反复出现时态、主谓一致或搭配错误并影响阅读；0分=多数句子不能理解。
格式与修订：按原题保持120–180词；新闻/书信/提案用对应体裁，明确要求的首句逐字保留。若超限、少写任务或缺必要格式，先修改再评分，不把字数达标当作内容满分。

questions.prompt: Many people today still find name hyphenation upon marriage unacceptable.
questions.passage:
Hyphenating your last name after marriage?

A) Congratulations on deciding to get married! While being married is great and wonderful, the act of getting married can be quite stressful. questions.prompt: Why is the U.S. State Department launching an online learning program for refugees?
questions.passage:
Of the endless troubles that come with being driven from one's home country, losing educational certificates may seem small. But it isn't. Refugees who settle in other countries often find themselves unable to continue on their previous career path due to a new set of employer standards or skills requirements. To solve this problem, the U.S. State Department is posing a solution: online learning.

The State Department will announce a partnership with an online education platform called Coursera. The platform will allow refugees worldwide to take thousands of online courses for free. "Coursera for Refugees" will be available for any non-profit group that supports refugees in any country, as well as individual refugees. They can apply for fully funded access to Coursera's course catalog, which means they can take all of the platform's classes and obtain professional certificates for free. The platform currently offers professor-led lectures on a broad range of topics, from data science to fashion design.

As the world migrant crisis intensifies, employment is becoming a global concern. The new program aims to aid refugees by offering "important skills that will help them in the global economy," Evan Ryan, U.S. assistant secretary of state for educational and cultural affairs, said on a press call last week. "What we don't want to do is not act," added Coursera chief operations officer Lila Ibrahim.

The idea isn't without problems. For one, starting a new career path isn't as simple as watching a few videos and obtaining an online certificate; even those looking to continue previous careers can't simply rely on an online lecture to get them up-to-date on standards, policies, and practices. For another, most of the classes on Coursera are in English, and though there are plans to add translations, language barriers can be a big obstacle. Then there are the questions over the value of massive open online courses (MOOCs) themselves—both for refugees and for average learners.

But it's still early days and there are signs of hope. In 2015, a joint study found 72% of people taking the MOOCs saw career benefits afterwards.

逐句核对：As living standards improve为增长背景，own/borrowed/rented vehicles三种车源齐全；driver can be owner or companion保留两类驾驶者。Unlike group tours说明与组团的比较，individual needs译个性化需求。enjoy the journey more fully强调旅游过程，especially popular among young travelers保留尤其年轻人。independent and free way of life是独立自由生活，meet precisely this need说明恰好满足。此题不是自动驾驶技术介绍。
rubric: 练习自评总分15分：信息准确0–8＋语法0–5＋表达0–2；允许拆句、换同义词，不要求逐字匹配参考译文。
信息准确0–8分：逐项检查——生活提高；自有/借/租车及驾驶者；与组团比较；个性需求和过程享受；年轻人独立自由需求。8分=全部关键信息正确；6–7分=少量次要细节遗漏；3–5分=多处遗漏/数字或关系误译；0–2分=核心人物、动作或逻辑严重错误。
语法0–5分：5分=时态、单复数、主谓一致、从句和介词基本正确；3–4分=少量错误仍易理解；1–2分=多处错误妨碍理解；0分=主要句子结构不可理解。
表达0–2分：2分=用词搭配自然、因果转折时间衔接清楚；1分=可理解但有中文式生硬表达；0分=词序/词义造成大面积理解困难。
修订操作：先在中文原题划出时间、数量、地点和连接词，再在自己的译文逐项找对应；为每处漏译或误译写一句修正。此分数是练习估计，不是官方阅卷或机器评分。
